sources.title: 《成宗實錄》卷223 1488年十二月二十四日徐居正卒记回载1458戊寅年奉命著《五行摠括》
sources.provider: 韩国国史编纂委员会／朝鲜王朝实录
sources.quality_notes: Seongjong Sillok vol223 1488 day 19-12-24, Han witness says under 戊寅 after Joseon King Sejo asks for 祿命書 to be investigated, 於時著《五行摠括》. 1458 composition account is retrospective in 1488 obituary, not surviving first print/copy, extant full treatise, original folio image nor reproducible algorithm. Preserve 摠 distinct from later 總 catalog normalization. No unique-copy or first-ever classification.

sources.title: 《正祖實錄》卷33 1791年十月二十七日观象监命课学取才与授课改革的汉文数字史录
sources.provider: 韩国国史编纂委员会／朝鲜王朝实录
sources.quality_notes: Jeongjo Sillok vol33 1791-10-27 戊辰, 3/3 item 觀象監進三學釐正節目. Contrasts 命課學今掌諏吉 and 專講祿命, distinguishes 科試法典不敢遽議 from 祿/別取才 re-test with 協紀辨方、象吉通書, specifies monthly school practice and winter/summer exams. One passage also prints 象告通書 versus multiple 象吉通書, do not silently normalize old glyph. Existing 1797 Jeongjo case remains a separate later statute event; examination regulation not proof of unbroken universal abolition of fortune telling.

sources.title: Kim Mantae 2013《徐居正的命理观：以〈五行摠括序〉〈筆苑雜記〉为中心》学术论文
sources.provider: KCI 韩国学术引文索引／《國學研究》
sources.quality_notes: Kim Mantae, Korean Studies (國學研究) 22 (2013):267-298, doi10.36093/ks.2013..22.009. Abstract considers 五行摠括 among earliest or possibly first Korean-composed myeongli books, and 笔苑雜記 an early occurrence of 四柱 term, describes Seo's Neo-Confucian mode of reasoning and critique of fraudulent practitioners. No original treatise scan, exhaustive earliest-term verification or negative-proof of prior Korean writings seen; do not elevate scholar's firstness claim or author preface mention to a physical 1458 book witness.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: 1458 author and book in 1488 obituary is not proof of a preserved treatise or an edition-to-edition copy relationship
1430 Joseon official teaching list and 1458 local composition are not proven direct copying
1791 regulation cannot be conflated with the separately documented 1797 readjustment or extrapolated to all private practice
unresolved_lineage_questions: Surviving edition/folio of 五行摠括 or earliest 五行摠括序 in 四佳集; original prose and rule family
Original received early witness of 笔苑杂记 occurrence of 四柱, dating of that physical copy
1791 象吉通書 versus 象告通書 textual control and causal/application relation to 1797 regulation
